instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js and .jsx files), NOT TypeScript (.tsx).
Keep mobile speed paramount: load fonts efficiently, keep DOM lightweight, and ensure smooth touch targets.
Live seats counter must start around 384/500 and dynamically update/reflect recent registrations from the backend API.

College field in registration modal should provide responsive autocomplete with popular Indian engineering colleges (IITs, NITs, BITS, VIT, SRM, Anna Univ, VTU, Manipal, Delhi Tech Univ, JNTU, Mumbai Univ, Pune Univ, etc.) plus allow custom typing.
Form must send POST /api/register to FastAPI backend, store registration in MongoDB, and route cleanly to /thank-you with prefilled student details.
Include simulated live registration ticker (e.g. 'Priya K. from RVCE just registered 2m ago') for social proof.

Add 'data-testid' on every interactive element: register-button, sticky-register-button, registration-modal, input-full-name, input-college, select-branch, select-grad-year, input-whatsapp, input-email, submit-registration, join-whatsapp-button, add-to-calendar-button, faq-accordion, countdown-timer, seats-progress-bar.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without muddy gradients. Stick to deep navy #070C18 with electric lime accents #10B981.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use crisp asymmetric bento containers and distinct micro-typography.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and delicate 1px border strokes (border-white/10).
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and floating CTAs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition like 'transition: all'. Explicitly add transitions for transform, opacity, background-color.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons; use clean Lucide SVG icons instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover states, smooth accordion spring, modal overlay enter/exit.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12) to give sections breathing room.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
